descricao_original: A Volkmann’s canal is visible in this longitudinal section of decalcified cortical bone. Volkmann’s and Haversian canals convey blood vessels and both are lined by endosteum. Some cells visible in the lumens may also be those of endothelial cells lining blood vessels. 400x
creditos_identificados: Image credit: This image was taken of slide in the Nova Southeastern University collection.
